data.say: Made workmen one term throughout (scaffolders to workmen in p148) and unified verse-like to the hyphenated house form (p73 to match p160). Left it's/It's/its, well/we'll/Well, head's/heads, and quoted forms like 'dream', 'trip', 'snowscape', 'Nancy Lee' and sailors'/chorus alone as sentence case, contractions, possessives, or deliberate quotation, not spelling variants.
data.summary: Unified workmen and verse-like; left case, possessive, contraction, and quoted variants alone on purpose.
